`final class ResourceAnimationCanvas`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.animation` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ResourceAnimationCanvas.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/animation/ResourceAnimationCanvas.java)

Builds the full images of an animation from frames that update only a part of the picture, as GIF, APNG and WebP store them.

## Description

Create one per file at the size of the animation, then compose each frame in order.

## Method details

<a id="ResourceAnimationCanvas-method-compose"></a>

### compose

`int[] compose(int[] frame, int x, int y, int frameWidth, int frameHeight, Blend blend, Disposal disposal)` 

Draws `frame`, of `frameWidth` × `frameHeight` pixels, at `x`, `y` with `blend`, returns the full image that results, then prepares the canvas for the next frame as `disposal` says.
The part of the frame outside the canvas is ignored.

<a id="ResourceAnimationCanvas-method-getWidth"></a>

### getPixels
